          <details id="unruh-course" class="lecture-material">
            <summary>Accelerated frames and the Unruh effect</summary>
            <div class="lecture-material-body">
              <p>Five Russian-language HTML lectures, from Rindler coordinates and entanglement entropy to the Unruh effect for scalar and fermion fields.</p>

                <a class="lecture-action-primary" href="../qft-lectures/unruh/">Open mini-course</a>
              </div>
            </div>

          <details id="qft-vacuum-course" class="lecture-material">
            <summary>Quantum field vacuum</summary>
            <div class="lecture-material-body">
              <p>A Russian-language mini-course on the QFT vacuum. Its first HTML lecture covers the wave functional of a free scalar field, the Gaussian vacuum, and how vacuum configurations differ from white noise.</p>
              <p>In preparation.</p>
            </div>
          </details>

                <a class="lecture-action-primary" href="../qft-lectures/en/slides/ScalarQEDAttractionRepulsion.html">HTML slides</a>
              </div>
